name: CreateSwimLaneGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance
parameters.name: service_mesh_id

parameters.help_en: The services to associate with the swimlane group. The value must be a JSON array. The format for a single service is `$ClusterName/$ClusterID/$Namespace/$ServiceName`
parameters.help_zh: 泳道组下关联的服务列表，取值为JSON数组。单个服务的格式为：` $集群名称/$集群id/$namespace/$serviceName`
parameters.name: services_list

parameters.help_en: The name of the swimlane group
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The type of Ingress traffic. Only ASM gateways are supported
parameters.help_zh: 入口流量类型，目前仅支持ASM网关
parameters.name: ingress_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the ASM gateway used for traffic routing. A gateway rule that has the same name as the ASM gateway is required. For ASM instances of v1.17.2.28 or later, you can specify the name of a gateway rule. The gateway rule does not need to have the same name as the ASM gateway
parameters.help_zh: 用于引流的ASM网关名称，使用时要求必须创建于ASM网关同名的网关规则。对于1.17.2.28版本以上的实例，则可以指定为网关规则的名称，网关规则不一定和ASM网关同名
parameters.name: ingress_gateway_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to create the swimlane in loose mode
parameters.help_zh: 创建的流量泳道是否是宽松模式
parameters.name: is_permissive

parameters.help_en: The request header for passing through requests in a loose-mode swimlane group. This parameter is required if IsPermissive is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 宽松模式泳道组的链路透传请求头。当IsPermissive参数为true时，此参数为必填
parameters.name: trace_header

parameters.help_en: The request header for routing traffic in a loose-mode swimlane group. This parameter is required if IsPermissive is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 宽松模式流量泳道组的引流请求头。当IsPermissive参数为true时，此参数为必填
parameters.name: route_header

parameters.help_en: The namespace of the gateway rule used to route traffic for the swimlane group. This parameter is available for ASM instances of v1.17.2.28 or later
parameters.help_zh: 用于泳道组引流的网关规则所在的命名空间，1.17.2.28版本以上的实例可以指定
parameters.name: ingress_gateway_namespace
